Barbara, Fischl, Xiangling, and eight others were already playable at launch — their first tracked banner appearance is technically a rerun, not a debut.
Tighnari, Dehya, and Mizuki aren't truly limited — they're on permanent rate-down, meaning they can appear even off their own banner.
Version 1.3's second phase (Keqing) was inserted as filler, timed to avoid landing Hu Tao's funeral-parlor-themed banner near Chinese New Year.
Version 2.7 was delayed about three weeks by the 2022 Shanghai COVID lockdown — versions 3.0 through 3.2 each ran a shortened 35-day cycle afterward to recover the lost time.
Some versions get a special Chronicled Wish banner, bringing back a whole past region's roster at once — except its Archon, who's mysteriously never invited.
Version cycles run on a well-known 42-day cadence — though a handful of versions have deviated, running anywhere from 35 to 62 days.
